SPECIMEN DETAILS
Specimen Type: Lymph node biopsy
Anatomical Site: [redacted location]
Clinical Diagnosis: DLBCL (Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma)

TEST PERFORMED
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH)

METHODOLOGY
FISH analysis was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue sections from lymph node biopsy. No chromosome analysis was performed as the specimen was designated for FISH studies only.

RESULT
No chromosome analysis performed; sample designated for FISH studies only.

INTERPRETATION
This specimen was received specifically for FISH analysis. G-banded chromosome analysis was not requested and not performed on this sample.

RECOMMENDATIONS
G-banded chromosome analysis not required; proceed with FISH studies as ordered.

NOTE: This report documents specimen receipt and designation for FISH studies. Results of FISH analysis will be reported separately upon completion.

**FILE ONLY**
